channel.title: Service Accounts on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Service Accounts on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a Service Account
item.description: This section describes how to create a service account. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the cluster-admin role in the cluster. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-admin role and go to your cluster. Click Configuration > Service Accounts in the left navigation pane. On the Service Account list page, click Create.

item.title: View Service Account List
item.description: This section describes how to view the list of service accounts. Prerequisites You need to be a member of a cluster and have the cluster-viewer role within the cluster. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-viewer role and enter your cluster. Click Configuration > Service Accounts in the left navigation pane. The Service Account list provides the following information:

item.title: View Service Account Details
item.description: This section describes how to view service account details. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the cluster-viewer role within the cluster. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-viewer role and enter your cluster. Click Configuration > Service Accounts in the left navigation pane. In the service account list, click the name of a service account to open its details page.

item.title: Edit Service Account Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit the information of a service account. You can edit the alias and description of a service account. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a service account. Prerequisites You need to be a member of a cluster and have the cluster-admin role in the cluster. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-admin role and go to your cluster.

item.title: Modify Service Account Role
item.description: This section describes how to modify service account roles. You can control the permissions of a service account by assigning roles to it, enabling the service account to access specific resources and perform specific operations. Prerequisites You need to be a member of a cluster and have the cluster-admin role in the cluster. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-admin role and go to your cluster.

item.title: Delete Service Accounts
item.description: This section describes how to delete a service account. Warning After a service account is deleted, applications using the service account will not be able to access the KubeSphere cluster. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites You need to be a member of a cluster and have the cluster-admin role in the cluster. Delete a Single Service Account Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-admin role and go to your cluster.
